changelog: Affiliate commission engine (#3845): a plan can be month-aligned (`monthAligned`, `timeZone`, default Europe/Berlin) — the percent phase then starts at the beginning of the month the switch customer first paid in, and a customer's window runs whole calendar months from its first paying month (`monthStartInZone()`, `customerWindowEndsAt()`). A first payment's tier is chosen by the new `AffiliatePayment.listAmountMinor` (the price list's price, set for list-priced counts) when present; the percent earns on the paid `amountMinor`. Stored plans read as not month-aligned until saved; the plan form, the partner's terms box and the settings transfer carry the new fields.

en: Affiliate plan: commissions can be counted in calendar months — the percentage starts at the beginning of the month the switch customer arrives in, and each customer's period runs from the beginning of its first paying month. The one-off commission follows the price-list price.
tr: Affiliate planı: komisyon takvim ayına göre sayılabilir — yüzde, geçiş müşterisinin geldiği ayın başından başlar ve her müşterinin süresi ilk ödeme ayının başından sayılır. Tek seferlik komisyon fiyat listesi fiyatına göre belirlenir.
de: Affiliate-Plan: Provisionen können in Kalendermonaten gezählt werden — der Prozentsatz beginnt am Anfang des Monats, in dem der Wechselkunde hinzukommt, und die Laufzeit jedes Kunden zählt ab Beginn seines ersten Zahlungsmonats. Die Einmalprovision richtet sich nach dem Preislistenpreis.
